externalBlockers.owner: Controller of Publications, Government of India / Legal Custodian
externalBlockers.description: Full physical printed gazette publication of ECI Delimitation Order 2008 with official seal and watermark is an external physical instrument not stored in git repository.
missingArtifacts: Physical printed Gazette of India Extraordinary Part II Section 3(iii) Delimitation Order 2008 with authenticated seal
externalBlockers.currentMitigation: Digital legal extracts and repository roster evidence may support textual reconciliation, but physical Gazette custody/authenticity inspection remains unperformed in this Stage B research; do not treat this gate as closed.
externalBlockers.resolutionCriteria: Physical inspection and archival custody certification by authorized legal notary.

externalBlockers.description: Independent physical notary/third-party audit comparing checked-in text extracts against the physical printed gazette remains pending.
missingArtifacts: Line-by-line physical gazette comparison audit report
externalBlockers.currentMitigation: Repository parsing/tests do not substitute for independent physical transcription fidelity audit; no independent physical audit was performed in this Stage B research.
externalBlockers.resolutionCriteria: Signed independent audit certificate verifying bitwise/character fidelity against physical gazette.

externalBlockers.owner: Department of Posts / Survey of India (National Spatial Data Infrastructure)
externalBlockers.description: A complete authoritative vector polygon GIS boundary dataset for Department of Posts 6-digit PIN delivery beats has not been acquired. Publication/availability status is not conclusively established by the current source search.
missingArtifacts: Official national India Post GIS delivery beat polygon shapefile / GeoJSON dataset for 31 States/UTs
externalBlockers.currentMitigation: Existing PIN centroid mapping may assist lookup only; it does not establish polygon containment. Multi-AC PINs must fail closed and synthetic polygon generation remains prohibited.
externalBlockers.handoffCustodian: Geospatial Data Operations / India Post Liaison
externalBlockers.resolutionCriteria: Formal release and ingestion of official GIS delivery beat polygon layers from India Post GIS division.

externalBlockers.owner: Survey of India / Election Commission of India / Spatial Engineering Team
externalBlockers.description: Rigorous geometric GIS polygon overlay proving 100% spatial containment of postal delivery beats within statutory assembly constituency boundaries cannot be completed without official delivery beat polygons.
missingArtifacts: PostGIS ST_Contains topological containment matrix for all postal delivery beats against 4,123 AC boundaries
externalBlockers.currentMitigation: Containment framework is reported in the repository, but no complete official delivery-beat polygons were acquired in this Stage B research; no full national containment result is claimed.
externalBlockers.resolutionCriteria: Topological containment execution over official polygons demonstrating verified intersection/containment.

externalBlockers.owner: Chief Electoral Officers (CEOs) of 31 States/UTs / ECI Data Division
externalBlockers.description: Empirical crosswalk linking voter registration addresses and polling station locations to 6-digit PIN codes has not been ingested or verified against official electoral rolls across all states.
missingArtifacts: State CEO Polling Station Address Registers with verified 6-digit PIN mappings for 4,123 ACs
externalBlockers.currentMitigation: Schema/framework may be present, but a complete independently verified all-state polling-station/PIN crosswalk was not acquired in this Stage B research; no synthetic mappings are permitted.
externalBlockers.handoffCustodian: Electoral Data Operations / State CEO Liaisons
externalBlockers.resolutionCriteria: Ingestion and validation of official polling station address datasets from 31 State CEOs.

externalBlockers.owner: Independent CTO Adjudicator / Architecture Review Board
externalBlockers.description: Formal Stage B adjudication verdict and explicit CTO authorization required before any Stage C migration, staging database mutation, or production release can proceed (Rule IV-001).
missingArtifacts: Cryptographically signed Stage 1 / Stage 2 Staging Write Authorization Token
externalBlockers.currentMitigation: Air gap 100% maintained; staging execution plan verified; zero unmapped synthetic shortcuts; all 20 verification suites passing.
externalBlockers.resolutionCriteria: Formal CTO adjudication session, verification of test manifest, and authorized token issuance.

freezeDeclaration.freezeDirective: CTO Directive 153 remains historical; Directive 154 supersedes it prospectively only for Stage B repository research/implementation
freezeDeclaration.nextPermittedAction: Continue Stage B source acquisition and geometry validation; stop at Stage B boundary for adjudication. Stage C and later stages remain unauthorized.

sourceAcquisitionDecision.strategy: Legal instruments as legal truth; official ECI/CEO/state GIS layers as candidate digital geometry; community/national layers for discrepancy discovery only; formal custodian requests for missing data and physical evidence.
sourceAcquisitionDecision.notableFinding: India Geodata statewise shapefiles are explicitly labelled pre-2014 in their directory README and are not accepted as current geometry.
